title: 第853章 灵酒之争十二第852章 灵酒之争十一
lines: 其余各大州域的修士似乎也乐于见到这般局面——
群雄逐鹿，灵酒之争越激烈，便越能试探出各州真正的底蕴深浅。
片刻沉寂过后，一道道身影陆续从人群中起身，陆续踏入空地，轮番向钟锋发起挑战。
有南衡州苦修多年秘术的修士，刚一登台便催动压箱底手段，可对上钟锋圆满无缺的金系法则本源，漫天攻势尽数被锋利金刃层层切割拆解。
不过数十回合便灵力耗损严重，无力再战，垂首认输退下。
紧随其后登台的，是青胤州擅使毒道秘术的天骄，抬手间万千灰黑毒雾铺天盖地，转瞬遮蔽整片空地视野。
可金之法则修到高深时，天生具备涤荡邪秽、破万毒的特性。
就见钟锋周身流转的金色灵光一卷，漫天毒雾触之即消融殆尽，任凭他接连祭出数种压箱底毒术，始终难以近钟锋身侧半步，底牌尽出也毫无建树，只能遗憾落败。
还有一名赤凰州天骄踏步上前，一心想替先前惨败的邹衍洗刷赤凰州颜面，尽管实力不俗，可几番缠斗之后依旧败下阵来。
短短片刻功夫，南衡、青胤、赤凰等诸多州域修士接连登台，却无一例外尽数折损在钟锋手中。
一时间，此人横压全场，似乎真有无人可制的态势。
若再无更强之人出手，这坛星河溯元酿便要落入钟锋囊中。
就在此时，苍梧州席位方向，柳乘风忽然起身。
一袭蓝袍在灵晶灯的光影中微微摆动，他眉眼散漫不羁，嘴角却勾起一抹随性的笑意，声音清亮：
“这一轮你们可都别跟我抢，今日这擂台，就由我先上去会会这位玄金州前辈。”
“若是侥幸能拿下星河溯元酿，回头咱们平分，保管你们每个人都能喝上一口。”
沈逸尘与炎鸠闻言皆是一怔，欲言又止。
二人方才旁观全程，心底自然对钟锋有着自己的一番评判。
在二人看来，柳乘风此番登台实在太过冲动。
金峰对于金之法则的掌控领悟，甚至比姜望还要更深一筹，实力远胜他们此前交手过的任何一名天骄。
单凭柳乘风此前在苍梧州问道会上展露的水准，断然不可能是钟锋的对手，贸然上前只会自取其辱。
唯独一旁的姜望沉默不语，心中想法与二人截然不同。
柳乘风平日里看似嬉皮笑脸，闲散嬉闹，可他的天资绝对不比其他人低，修行速度绝对在沈逸尘、炎鸠之上。
而且他人也不傻，若是心中没有几分把握和底气，绝不会主动出头。
念头转瞬而过。
这时候柳乘风已经踏出苍梧州席位，缓步朝着空地中央走去，步伐悠然从容，不见半分紧张忐忑。
他一动，满堂众多目光齐刷刷汇聚在他身上，细碎的质疑与轻视之声不绝于耳。
“苍梧州的人竟然也敢上去，那人是谁，怎么之前从未听说过？”
“苍梧州能跻身一档争锋的，说到底也就姜望一人而已。”
“沈逸尘与炎鸠尚且还有几分可观实力，但这人看着吊儿郎当，能有几分真本事？怕是上去撑不过三招，就要被钟锋的金刃斩落。”
周遭诸多议论传入耳中，柳乘风恍若未闻，丝毫不受流言影响，径直走到钟锋对面，微微躬身拱手，语气坦荡：
“钟前辈，晚辈苍梧州柳乘风，特来向您讨教一二。”
钟锋淡淡抬眼扫了他一眼，眼底掠过一丝淡淡的不以为意，只当对方是年轻小辈一时意气上头，随口抬手，示意他先行出手。
柳乘风自然也不客气。
双生秘术率先催动，两道容貌、气息完全一致的身影分立左右
柳乘风在左，柳青云在右。
content_en:
The monks from other major states seemed to be happy to see this situation——
The fiercer the battle for spiritual wine among the heroes, the more they can test out the true depth of each state.
After a moment of silence, figures one after another stood up from the crowd, stepped into the open space one after another, and took turns challenging Zhong Feng.
There is a monk from Nanhengzhou who has been practicing secret arts for many years. As soon as he takes the stage, he activates the bottom-up method. When faced with Zhong Feng's flawless golden law, all the offensives in the sky are cut and dismantled by sharp golden blades.
However, after a few dozen rounds, his spiritual power was severely depleted and he was unable to fight anymore, so he bowed his head and resigned.
Immediately following him on the stage was Qingyinzhou's genius who was good at using the secret technique of the poisonous path. Thousands of gray and black poisonous mist covered the sky when he raised his hand, instantly blocking the entire field of view.
But when you cultivate the law of gold to a high level, you will be born with the ability to cleanse away evil and filth and break all poisons.
He saw a golden aura circulating around Zhong Feng, and the poisonous mist that filled the sky melted away upon contact. No matter how many poison techniques he used, he was still unable to get even half a step closer to Zhong Feng. Even after using all his trump cards, he failed to achieve anything, so he could only regretfully lose.
There was also a prodigy from the Red Phoenix State who stepped forward, intent on clearing the face of the Red Phoenix State for Zou Yan, who had suffered a heavy defeat earlier. Although he was very strong, he was still defeated after several fights.
In just a short period of time, Nanheng, Qingyin, Chihuang and many other state monks came on stage one after another, but without exception, they were all lost in the hands of Zhong Feng.
For a moment, this person dominated the entire field, and it seemed that no one could control him.
If no one stronger takes action, this altar of Xinghe Yuanyuan Brewing will fall into Zhong Feng's bag.
At this moment, in the direction of Cangwuzhou's seat, Liu Chengfeng suddenly stood up.
A blue robe swayed slightly in the light and shadow of the spiritual crystal lamp. His eyebrows were unruly, but a casual smile appeared at the corner of his mouth, and his voice was clear:
"Don't try to compete with me this round. I will go up to meet this senior Xuan Jinzhou first in today's arena."
"If you are lucky enough to win the Xinghe Origin Brewing, we will share it equally later and make sure that each of you can take a sip."
Shen Yichen and Yan Jiu were both startled when they heard this, but stopped talking.
The two of them had just watched the whole process, and naturally they had their own judgments about Zhong Feng in their hearts.
In their opinion, Liu Chengfeng's appearance on stage was too impulsive.
Jin Feng's understanding of the Golden Law is even deeper than Jiang Wang's, and his strength is far superior to any genius they have fought against before.
Based on Liu Chengfeng's previous performance at the Cangwu Zhou Conference, it was absolutely impossible for him to be Zhong Feng's opponent. He would only bring humiliation to himself if he rashly stepped forward.
Only Jiang Wang remained silent, his thoughts completely different from the two of them.
Liu Chengfeng seems to be playful and playful on weekdays, but his talent is definitely not lower than others, and his cultivation speed is definitely higher than that of Shen Yichen and Yan Jiu.
And others are not stupid. If they don't have some confidence and confidence in their hearts, they will never take the initiative.
The thought passed by in a flash.
At this time, Liu Chengfeng had already stepped out of Cangwuzhou's seat and walked slowly towards the center of the open space. His steps were leisurely and calm, without any trace of nervousness or apprehension.
As soon as he moved, many eyes in the room focused on him, and the sounds of doubts and contempt could be heard endlessly.
"People from Cangwu Prefecture dare to go up there. Who is that person? Why have I never heard of him before?"
"In the final analysis, only Jiang Wang is the only one in Cangwu Prefecture who can compete in the first tier."
"Shen Yichen and Yan Jiu still have some respectable strength, but this guy looks so careless, how capable he is? I'm afraid if he can't survive three moves, he will be chopped down by Zhong Feng's golden blade."
When Liu Chengfeng heard many comments around him, he seemed not to have heard them. He was not affected by the rumors at all. He walked straight to the opposite side of Zhong Feng, bowed slightly and held his hands in his hands, speaking in a magnanimous tone:
"Senior Zhong and junior Cangwuzhou Liu Chengfeng are here to ask you for advice."
Zhong Feng raised his eyes and glanced at him, with a hint of disinterest flashing across his eyes. He just thought that the other person was a young man, and he was so angry that he casually raised his hand to signal him to take action first.
Liu Chengfeng was naturally not polite either.
The secret technique of twins was activated first, and two figures with exactly the same appearance and aura separated left and right.
Liu Chengfeng is on the left and Liu Qingyun is on the right.
